audience: teams that send contracts and documents for e-signature with CloudSign

useCases.title: Check which documents still wait for signature
useCases.text: List the team's documents by status, then open one to see its files and participants. Status 1 means it waits for recipients.

useCases.title: Review the concluded documents
useCases.text: List the documents with status 2, concluded, and open one to read its files and participants.

useCases.title: Create a draft and send it for signature
useCases.text: Create a draft, upload the PDF, add the recipient, then send it. Recipients get an email at once, and sending cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Send a reminder for an unsigned document
useCases.text: Open the document to check its status. Then send it again, which emails the recipients a reminder.

useCases.title: Delete a draft that is no longer needed
useCases.text: Open the draft to check it, then delete it. Sent documents cannot be deleted.
